The '''Golan VIII space defense platform''' was a mobile [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. It was a member of the [[Golan space defense platform|Golan series]] of heavily-armed platforms.

==Description==
The Golan VIII was a Golan Arms [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] fitted with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for easier relocation. To operate it, the main power systems had to be re-routed as the class was primarily meant to defend a fixed location.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
One such station was used to guard the [[Black Redoubt]], a secret [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] logistics facility.<ref name="LECG" />
